contexts.text: The latter and the former are they who belong to the province of the cistern and ducts of the chyle.
As the chyle is carried through the mesentery and the lacteal vessels there into the receptacle...
The chyle conveyed through the thoracic duct from its receptacle in the mesentery...
Thought is like a water-course, and the speech thence is like a cistern.
Cisterns dug () = the interiors of the natural mind full of the Knowledges of good and truth.
Cisterns cut out () = all things of intelligence in the natural man, which are cognitions and scientifics.
